tsbs.title: Head gasket can leak coolant (coverage until May 2027)
tsbs.plain_summary: On some 2016-2017 Civics with the 1.5L turbo and CVT automatic, the head gasket can stop sealing well. The engine may run hot, lose coolant or misfire. Honda covers this part until May 31, 2027 or 150,000 miles. A Honda dealer checks your VIN.

coverage.term: until May 31, 2027 or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first

tsbs.title: Hybrid engine software update for engine temperature
tsbs.plain_summary: Honda is updating engine computer software on some 2025-2026 Civic Hybrids. The update changes how the electric water pump runs, to help keep engine temperature in check. Honda planned to start telling owners in September 2026. A dealer can check your VIN.
